name: lago-billing
description: Inspects and edits the application open in your workspace to implement and validate Lago billing. No credentials are needed for offline work; Lago access is needed only for live validation.

interface.shortDescription: Implement Lago in the application open in your workspace.
interface.longDescription: Open an application repository, then invoke the plugin. It inspects the stack and existing billing architecture before editing. Offline work needs no Lago credentials or MCP connection; live sandbox validation needs Lago access, and production actions require separate approval.
defaultPrompt: Implement Lago in the application currently open in this workspace. First confirm the repository, explain what you can do offline, inspect the existing architecture, and ask only for blocking decisions.
